observations.label: Kerhonkson sightseeing — Minnewaska State Park Preserve
observations.quote:
Minnewaska State Park Preserve (Kerhonkson/Minnewaska Region)
The crown jewel of regional sightseeing is the Minnewaska State Park Preserve. This massive 24,000-acre preserve rests atop the Shawangunk Ridge and features striking white quartzite cliffs, dense forests, and rare sky lakes.
